title: Real and Wild Texture Procreate Brushes
author: Khrystyna Turchyn

fullDescription:
Add authentic depth, grit, and natural realism to your digital artwork with the “Real and Wild Texture” Procreate brush set! This collection of 23 high-quality seamless texture brushes is designed to bring the raw, organic beauty of the natural world and urban environments straight to your iPad canvas.
Whether you’re painting landscapes, adding grunge to character designs, or creating textured backgrounds, this versatile toolkit has exactly what you need to make your art stand out.

What’s Included:
23 Unique Texture Brushes in one convenient `.brushset` file.
A wide variety of organic and gritty surfaces, including:
Rough tree bark and wood grains.
Rocky surfaces and stone textures.
Brickwork and urban grunge.
Organic foliage, moss, and earthy ground textures.
Distressed and speckled patterns for shading and depth.

Perfect For:
Landscape & Environment Design: Instantly add realistic textures to trees, mountains, ground, and foliage.
Concept Art: Quickly block in detailed surfaces and materials.
Character Design: Add wear-and-tear, dirt, or unique material textures to clothing and armor.
Illustration & Backgrounds: Break away from flat colors by adding subtle grain or bold, gritty backgrounds.
Lettering & Typography: Create distressed, vintage, or rugged text effects.

What you will receive:
1 `.brushset` file containing all 23 brushes.
How to Install:

Download the ZIP file to your iPad.
Unzip the file using the Files app.
Tap on the `.brushset` file to automatically import the brushes into Procreate.

**PLEASE NOTE:** These brushes are designed exclusively for the Procreate App on the iPad and will not work in Photoshop or any other software. An Apple Pencil is recommended for the best experience.

Bring your digital canvas to life with the raw, untamed beauty of the Real and Wild Texture brush set!
